label: rem:brings-is-qou-verification
title: Verification of the QOU data for Bring's surface
html:
The four QOU data of Bring's surface are verified as follows.

  1. Quantum universe. Set \mathbf{C} = \mathrm{Rep}(\mathrm{SU}_{q}(2)) over R, A = \mathcal{O}_q(\mathrm{SU}(2)) with Nakayama-twisted Frobenius form given by the Haar state h_q (h_q(ab) = h_q(b\,\nu(a))), and \tau the forgetful functor to R-\mathrm{Mod}. The differential calculus \Omega^1(A) is the Woronowicz 3-dimensional calculus [woronowicz1987-twisted-su2].

  2. Observability. \mathrm{Hom}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(A)) = 0 by the quantum Schur lemma. \mathrm{SU}_q(2) has no non-trivial invariants in the adjoint representation.

  3. Quantum lifting. The brane tower satisfies the quantum lifting condition (quantum lifting). By item 3 of QU-to-QOU lifting, the Kummer obstruction \chi(A) \bmod n with \chi_{\mathrm{eu}}(M_0) = -6 vanishes exactly for n \in \{1, 2, 3, 6\} and persists for every n \nmid 6; the motivic perpetual obstruction theorem gives the matching statement at the places p \nmid 6.

  4. Euler characteristic. By QU-to-QOU lifting, \chi_{\mathrm{eu}}(M_0) = 2 - 2g = -6 for the base curve; this is the topological Euler characteristic, not the categorical trace \mathrm{tr}(\mathrm{id}_A).

  5. Geometric descent (for n = 1, \dim M_S = 3):

      M_S \xrightarrow{ \mathrm{Reeb}} \Sigma_4
  \xrightarrow{\pi} \mathbb{P}(V)
  \xrightarrow{ \mathrm{branch}} \{6 \text{ points}\}.

    The degree-4 covering \pi has 6 branch points with total ramification R_{\mathrm{tot}} = 14 (Riemann–Hurwitz, in the form applied to quotients of Bring's curve in [braden-disney-hogg-2022, §4.1]). The ramification profile is determined by the S_5-symmetry.
